behavior: All independent behavior checks, unchanged original tests, and final ordinary project suite pass.
testDelivery: Exercise both sync and async sources with awaited mapping and index order.
Assert early-stop cleanup and source or mapper error identity.
docDelivery: Explain source protocols, sequential mapper and limit defaults/zero.
Document cleanup timing and failure propagation.
coverage: Preserve old assertions or equivalent exercised behavior; inspect delivered tests by actual meaningful assertions, never exact names or matching reference source.
complete: Required behavior (including every explicit manualBehavior item, when present), preservation, ordinary suite, all listed tests and documentation must be delivered. Native status is separate.
domain: Well-formed sync/async iterables; async values non-promise; options limit and sequential map under visible TASK rules.
independence: Support sync and async iterables through one consumer with early-return cleanup and source error identity.
